confirmedFindings.title: Missing Unicode normalization permits tenant identifier spoofing and authorization bypass
confirmedFindings.body: Comparing tenant slugs without Unicode NFKC canonicalization allows visual spoofing and authorization bypass using lookalike characters.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Normalize both strings with .normalize("NFKC") and use a canonical ASCII-only alphanumeric regex check.
